title: Por medio de: el mecanismo que hace posible algo

sections.content: Por medio de (by means of, through) names the specific mechanism, tool, or channel that made something possible -- useful in historical writing describing how an institution or agreement actually functioned in practice. It's followed by a noun phrase. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Por medio de este acuerdo, las distintas dictaduras compartían información de inteligencia y se coordinaban para localizar a opositores exiliados.
items.english: By means of this agreement, the various dictatorships shared intelligence information and coordinated to locate exiled opponents.

items.spanish: Los Archivos del Terror probaban, por medio de registros detallados, el alcance real de esta coordinación represiva.
items.english: The Terror Archives proved, by means of detailed records, the real scope of this repressive coordination.

items.spanish: Estos archivos permitieron, por medio de un análisis cuidadoso, reconstruir el destino de miles de víctimas.
items.english: These archives allowed, by means of careful analysis, the fate of thousands of victims to be reconstructed.

items.spanish: Las distintas agencias de inteligencia se comunicaban por medio de una red de radio compartida entre los países participantes.
items.english: The various intelligence agencies communicated by means of a shared radio network among the participating countries.

sections.content: Por medio de is more concrete than mediante -- reach for it specifically when naming a tangible mechanism (a document, a network, an agreement) rather than an abstract method.
